items.name: lit-review-synthesis
items.title: Lit Review Synthesis
items.description: Build a literature review as an argument from paper-reader notes: cluster the notes into themes, surface agreements, tensions, and methodological patterns, locate the gap the thesis fills, and draft the review chapter so that each paragraph advances a claim rather than summarising one paper. Every citation comes from the notes and the .bib. Use when the reading is done and the related-work or background chapter needs writing, or when a draft review reads like an annotated bibliography.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
